name: ruflo-mods
description: ruflo as a Claude Code mod (function hooks, ADR-404): in-process prompt routing, edit learning signals, tighten-only tool checks from ruflo policy, the cost-tracker budget ladder, a mod trust gate for newly installed mods, and the $.ruflo noun other mods compose their status with. Opt-in and removable: the classic hook-handler hooks stay the default and take every event back whenever the mod is not loaded.

routeContext.title: Ranked memory with routes
routeContext.description: Add the ranked-memory block (.claude-flow/data/ranked-context.json) to each prompt's routing context, as the classic route hook does.

statusLine.title: ruflo status line
statusLine.description: Show a one-line ruflo status under the prompt. Never shown where the ruflo statusLine helper is already configured.

costBudgetUsd.title: Session budget (USD)
costBudgetUsd.description: Apply the cost-tracker budget ladder (50/75/90/100%) to this session's live cost. 0 turns it off.

costHardStop.title: Halt agents at 100% of budget
costHardStop.description: At 100% of the session budget, refuse new subagent spawns.

modTrust.title: Mod trust gate
modTrust.description: How ruflo treats a hooks module installed or hot-reloaded after it (a mod Claude wrote, say). "observe" (default): name what it can do (host commands, network, environment, file writes, tool verdicts) in the transcript. "refuse-risky": refuse user-tier mods that can do any of those, unless listed in modTrustAllow. "off": do not watch.

modTrustAllow.title: Trusted mods (plugin ids)
modTrustAllow.description: Comma-separated plugin ids as Claude Code keys them, name@marketplace (e.g. ruflo-swarm@ruflo,ruflo-console@ruflo), that the trust gate never refuses. Matched on where the plugin was installed from, not on the name it gives itself.
